notes_for_editor: County conflict left unresolved: Firelookout.org (record) says Cochise; Forest Lookouts says Santa Cruz. Record not changed; the story names both. The 1936 build date rests on Forest Lookouts quoting an Army history PDF (huachuca.army.mil/files/History_Sense.pdf); that PDF timed out twice and was not read. The DENIX history PDF was grepped and has no lookout mention, so the date is single-sourced. The DENIX PDF names Miller Peak (9,466 ft) as the highest point in the Huachuca Mountains; not used. No access rule found for a site on an Army post; access left unset. Record coordinates 31.49061, -110.38253 are within about 20 m of the local GNIS cache (31.49077, -110.38242); no action. Verification 2026-10-10: the 1930 event was relabelled from staffed_first to announced because the newsletter reports an agreed plan, not confirmed staffing.
